name: The Stomach
overview: Scripture addresses the stomach not only as a physical necessity but also as a symbol of spiritual and moral condition. The Proverbs highlight the connection between what a person speaks and their satisfaction, indicating that the fruit of the mouth can fill the belly, while warnings about wine and strong drink reveal the dangers of excess and deception. Jesus clarifies that external things entering the stomach do not defile a person, shifting focus from physical consumption to spiritual purity. Ephesians contrasts drunkenness with being filled by the Spirit, urging believers to seek spiritual fulfillment rather than indulgence.
